faultSummary: Condenser fan motor failure — unit not cooling. E07 fault code on control board.
resolutionSummary: Replaced condenser fan motor (DK-FAN-12A) and control board. Unit tested at setpoint for 30 minutes.

faultSummary: Refrigerant leak detected — low charge causing poor cooling performance.
resolutionSummary: Located leak at flare joint on indoor unit liquid line. Recovered, repaired, recharged to 2.3 kg R410A.

faultSummary: Annual preventive maintenance — filter clean, coil wash, controls check.
resolutionSummary: Completed PPM schedule. Filters cleaned, indoor/outdoor coils washed. All controls functional. Minor refrigerant top-up 0.1 kg.

faultSummary: Noisy operation — rattling from outdoor unit at startup.
resolutionSummary: Tightened loose compressor mounting bolts. Replaced worn anti-vibration grommets. Noise eliminated on test.

faultSummary: Drainage blockage — water leaking from indoor unit onto ceiling tiles.
resolutionSummary: Cleared condensate drain blockage (algae build-up). Fitted condensate treatment tablet. Drain pan cleaned.
